summary: Friedman Industries filed an 8-K reporting a Seventh Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated May 19, 2021, entered September 3, 2026 with JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent and lenders. The amendment raises aggregate commitments from $140 million to $200 million and makes conforming changes to threshold amounts, aligning facility size with borrowing-base growth. No equity, ownership, premium or deal terms arise. The company cites the increase as routine financing; the full amendment will be filed as an exhibit to its September 30, 2026 Form 10-Q.
